source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check if BP can detect NVMe sucessfully

1. Insert NVMe switch adapter and power on.
2. Boot into BIOS and check NVMe SSD in NVMe switch adapter information correctly.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Can enter into BIOS without any problems.
2. The controller info displays correctly.

original_test_intent: Verify that the approved NVMe switch adapter and all mapped NVMe SSDs are physically installed and powered correctly, that BIOS opens normally and displays the expected adapter/controller/device information, with OS inventory used only as supplemental identity and health correlation.
original_method: A qualified operator installs the exact adapter and SSD topology in a safe power state, powers on, enters BIOS and visually records every controller/device field; after boot, the agent may collect serial/model/size/link/health and logs for the same allowlisted devices and reconcile them with the BIOS evidence.
manual_activity: Core steps require physical insertion of the NVMe switch adapter and human navigation/visual inspection of BIOS controller information. The agent cannot claim either action; OS commands can only supplement the operator's BIOS evidence, so the complete case is MANUAL ONLY.
required_inputs: Exact NVMe switch adapter, PCIe slot, backplane/cabling and expected lane/topology
Board/BIOS version and exact BIOS pages/fields that constitute correct controller information
Qualified operator, safe power/ESD procedure and KVM/console access
Allowlisted OS device/namespace mapping and approved smartmontools/nvme inventory commands
safety_requirements: Power and service the system according to the adapter installation SOP; use ESD controls and never insert an internal PCIe adapter live unless explicitly supported.
Verify slot, keying, seating, cables and power before startup; stop on resistance, damage, instability or unexpected topology.
Keep OS verification read-only and restricted to allowlisted NVMe devices; do not scan or operate on unrelated sd disks by broad pattern.
Preserve BIOS/OS mismatch and error logs; do not reseat, reset or retry automatically.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare the topology/field/serial evidence matrix and validate safe-state prerequisites.
After the operator supplies BIOS/KVM evidence, run approved read-only inventory/health/log queries for the exact mapped NVMe namespaces.
Reconcile BIOS and OS identity evidence and report discrepancies as Tool Result without claiming the manual work or verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the adapter/SSD topology and physically install it under the hardware SOP.
Enter BIOS and visually attest controller/device information for every expected SSD.
Resolve any BIOS/OS mapping discrepancy and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `lsblk`/`smartctl` is supplemental OS evidence only; it cannot establish BIOS entry/display or adapter mechanics. Grepping both nvme and sd broadens scope beyond the named NVMe topology, and `head -40` may discard required fields.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain operator BIOS inspection. For supplemental automation, query only allowlisted NVMe controllers/namespaces with complete identity/health output and correlate serials to BIOS fields.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Adapter insertion/power-on, BIOS controller display check and 15/8-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: MANUAL BIOS EVIDENCE PLUS TARGETED NVME INVENTORY
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a topology manifest linking physical slot, adapter port, BIOS controller field and OS PCI/NVMe namespace/serial, with full KVM screenshots and targeted read-only NVMe health output.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact adapter, motherboard slot, backplane and BIOS implementation.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, adapter/switch firmware, SSD firmware, OS/kernel and inventory-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project topology/BOM, BIOS UI specification and adapter/backplane installation documentation must be supplied.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds end-to-end identity correlation without replacing physical installation or BIOS observation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; BIOS accessibility and displayed controller information remain primary acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Topology and expected BIOS field matrix.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS enumeration may succeed despite incomplete or differently rendered BIOS information and cannot prove physical handling quality.

project_override_considerations: A project may define its SSD population and expected BIOS fields. Devices not installed under that approved topology must be reported out of scope, not silently treated as detected.
expected_evidence: Adapter/slot/backplane/cabling and per-SSD slot/serial/model map plus safe installation attestation
Operator-attributed BIOS entry and controller/device screenshots covering every expected field
BIOS-to-OS reconciliation, relevant boot/storage/BMC logs, Tool Result and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The backplane-detection statement, BIOS procedure and controller-display criteria are consistent parts of the same topology check.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The topology and BIOS-display intent are clear. Missing hardware or expectations are readiness inputs; the physical and visual core is MANUAL ONLY.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains its read-only OS evidence but rejects YES because it omits the defining physical/BIOS steps.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains topology, operator and BIOS evidence gates while applying the strict MANUAL ONLY rule for human BIOS observation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds exact PCIe-to-BIOS-to-namespace identity correlation and removes broad unintended-disk enumeration.

review_improvement: Prevents OS inventory from being misrepresented as BIOS validation and makes every NVMe device traceable through the switch topology.
independent_technical_reasoning: Physical adapter insertion and visual BIOS display correctness are core acceptance steps, not mere setup for an automated test. Therefore the complete case is MANUAL ONLY; read-only OS tools remain valuable but non-equivalent supplemental evidence.
